rule_summary: Equipment terminations for circuits rated 100 amperes or less, or marked for 14 AWG through 1 AWG, are used with 60°C conductors or with higher-rated conductors sized at their 60°C ampacity, unless the equipment is listed and identified for higher-rated conductors; a motor item allows 75°C. Over 100 amperes or larger than 1 AWG, terminations are used with 75°C conductors or higher-rated conductors limited to 75°C ampacity. (Tier-4 text only.)
